items.title: Voice Card 04
items.author: Witness Spool
pages: EAST THROAT / 23:16 / recorder open. Rook: If the route closes behind us, will three cuts on its reverse face still mean return? The camp transcript has no written copy.
LOWER RELAY / 02:11 / output: THREE CUTS STILL MEAN RETURN. Recorder custody between entries: Wren.

items.title: Voice Card 07
items.author: Witness Spool
pages: LOW FIRE / 01:42 / cameras packed. mkept: If it learns our names, can it follow those names home? The typed camp log ends before this sentence.
LOWER RELAY / 03:06 / output: NAMES GO HOME BEFORE BODIES. Fire watch present: mkept and Wren.

items.title: Voice Card 11
items.author: Witness Spool
pages: WELL ROPE / 04:03 / main recorder paused. Ash: If one of us vanishes, will the rest remember the shape they left? The monitor spool retained the exchange.
LOWER RELAY / 04:19 / output: THE SHAPE LEFT BEHIND IS ALSO A PERSON. Monitor spool signed out to Wren.

items.title: Wick Layer A
items.author: Lamp House
pages: WICK TRAY / Layer A / oldest surviving char. Tray recess 1. Layers A through C were lifted as one continuous section.
Maintenance sheet records steady oil use through bell six. The next inspection is the first with no fresh draw.

items.title: Wick Layer B
items.author: Lamp House
pages: WICK TRAY / Layer B / middle surviving char. Tray recess 2, immediately after Layer A.
No new oil appears above this char. Later tray recesses are unused, not missing samples.

items.title: Wick Layer C
items.author: Lamp House
pages: WICK TRAY / Layer C / newest surviving char. Tray recess 3. Recesses 4 through 6 were clean when the lamp was opened.
The house's own dial is stopped, not running. Read what it stopped at; do not guess it.

items.title: Discipline Drafts A/B
items.author: Civic Office
pages: DRAFT A / Lower-draw procedure followed. Replacement cloth sheds under load. Quarantine Invoice 44, suspend the public tap, and open a supplier inquiry. Nessa Vale remains a witness.
DRAFT B / Worker mishandled samples and failed to maintain pressure. Supplier inquiry and lower-draw exhibit removed. Terminate Nessa Vale before cycle 5.
COPY REVIEW / Nessa's mark on Draft B was lifted from her cycle-2 receipt. Revision ink matches Heat Office stock. Draft A retains the original Cistern filing cuts.
